title: Analysis Run Metadata
description: Pipeline provenance record for an analysis run. One item per scope, recording what models, resources, and modes were used to produce the analysis items for that scope.

model.description: Primary model ID used to produce the analysis (e.g. 'gpt-5.4').

critic_model.description: Model ID used for critic/review pass, if any.

analysis_type.description: The analysis type this metadata describes (e.g. 'interpresure_suggestions').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was produced.

biblical_language.description: ISO 639-3 code for the biblical source language consulted (e.g. 'grc' for Greek, 'hbo' for Biblical Hebrew).

resources.description: Map of resource name to boolean indicating whether it was used.
